note: The contract 0x499dd9 bought 905428.168460 SPICE for 1.060936 WETH on the SPICE/WETH V3 pool 0xa0b6ef. The victim then bought SPICE on that pool, and the contract sold the same SPICE back for 1.260769 WETH (+0.199833). I treat the sender and the contract as one actor, so the 0.151329 ETH the sender passed through the contract to 0x829bd8 (likely a builder or miner payment) is an outflow; netting it out and subtracting 0.1365 ETH of gas leaves a loss, though if that payment were excluded the result would be about +0.063 ETH.
